comments.author: CA-RvZ
comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Meditations

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on Ancient Roman Emperor's Relic
Skill requirement: r12 Search, r14 Archaeology, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: Emperor Commodus' sword discovery (from "The blood thirsty tyrant" quest)
Required Sophia rank: 4
Sophia cost: 300 points

comments.author: viller
comments.body: Any idea why i can't see this quest on my further research quests list? Prediscovery/Sophia rank are ok.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Do your skill search/archaeology ranks match the minimum requirements? Further Research quests will not be visible if skill ranks, Sophia rank and/or prediscovery requirements are not met.

With r10 search and r12 archaeology (refined), there are only 2 visible Sophia quests under Relics. But when I change jobs or put on boost equipment (search r13, archaeology r14), 5 quests are visible, including this one. I hope that helps; cheers and let us know if you need further help.

comments.author: viller
comments.body: Yes, skill rank was the reason why, changed job and now quest is visible. Many thanks!
